lines.en: Some nights I dream of things my brother tells me to ignore.
But in my sleep I can’t control the grip of her allure.
The way she combs my hair; how she moves across the floor.
There will always be a limit to how much I can endure.
You kissed me after this one.
: KYAAAAAAAH! Onii-chan’s sleeping face!
: Onee-chan...you seriously mean to tell me you get to wake up to this every day of the week?
: You’re just lucky he’s wearing clothes this time.
: Am I really, though? Like...would it really be so bad if, as both his sister and sort of his sister in-law, for me to just...accidentally see his penis in the morning?
: Yes.
: Not even with your permission?
: Why would I give you my permission, you fucking psychopath?!
: Because you love me!
: Not that much! Find your own penis! I mean...boyfriend!
: But sisters are supposed to share. And you always give me your hand-me-downs.
: I wouldn’t have if Mom didn’t pressure me to.
: So you’re telling me if Mom pressures you into letting me have a turn with Onii-chan-
: It’s not going to happen, Noriko! Now stop wanting to fuck your brother! I deal with incestual tendencies enough on a day-to-day basis! I don’t need you adding to that!
: Hey, are you guys talking about incest in there?
: Great! Now look what you’ve done!
: What if you just cover his eyes for a few minutes and let me...you know...sample him a little bit? Heheh...
: Akira! Get out of the fucking bed already! I know you’re awake!
: Ugh...how did you know?
: Because you kept opening your fucking eyes, idiot. Some backup would’ve been nice, you know.
: I’m sorry, Niki. But unlike you, I’m actually kind to my little sister.
: Perhaps too kind if you can hear all of that and not tell her to knock it off.
: Noriko’s her own girl and I won’t tell her how to live her life. Just one more example of me being a better sibling than you.
: I love you, Onii-chan!
: That’s nice, Noriko.
: Gah! Being rejected so early in the morning is doing unspeakable things to me! If only someone could teach me what to do with these sudden urges!
: I hate both of you. But I am pleased to announce that I won’t have to for much longer as we are leaving.
: Oh, really? Did Ami finally convince you to move back out?
: No, asshole! I meant I’m leaving for the weekend. And I’m taking Noriko and Ami with me. That’s why I’m waking you up so early. To say goodbye.
: Ahh. I thought it was kind of weird that you weren’t waking me up in the normal way.
: What’s the normal way?
: Unfortunately, this means you’ll have to wake yourself up until we get back on Monday. And also cook for yourself. Which basically means you’ll wind up ordering.
: That said, I left all of the menus out on the dining room table so you don’t text me a million times looking for them instead of just using DoorDash like a god damn adult.
: Onii-chan, what’s the normal way?
: What’s with the sudden trip? And why am I not invited?
: It’s not sudden. I’ve told you about it every day this week. You’re just a fucking idiot and only retain information directly relevant to your dick.
: Well, that’s clearly not true because your absence is very relevant to my dick.
: Can somebody tell me what the normal way is?! I have a very understandable and rational interest in what the two of you do together!
: Act innocent all you like, twerp. We both know you’re mature enough to have figured out what that meant immediately.
: If I’m so mature, why won’t you let me sample my brother? Huh, Nee-chan? What’s the reasoning behind that?
: The same reason I won’t let you wear this sweater. It’s my property and I’m not done with it yet.
: Fine! Then I guess I’ll just have to be a good girl and act more like a normal little sister until you are!
: That’s...yeah. That’s exactly what I want, actually. I think I just won.
: Of course you won. You’re older. You always win.
: That just means I get to spend more time with Onii-chan, though! And none of it will be suspicious!
: Oh good. So exactly the way things are supposed to be.
: That said, your special sibling time won’t begin until after our trip. Now, please excuse me while I go make sure the real incest demon is packed.
: Bye, Nee-chan! This is the part where I’d normally make some kind of joke about locking the door! But I won’t do that now since I’m going full sister-mode from now on!
: And how long will that last, do you think?
: Until you get me really flustered and tell me you want to do me or something. You know. Regular little sister stuff.
: Where are you guys even going? And...why are you going without me? Am I not a part of this family anymore?
: Of course you are, Onii-chan! And perhaps the most important part of all since you’re the only one who possesses the genetic capability to extend and grow our family.
: Yeah. That’s not really doable by myself, though.
: Sure. But if you take just one of us girls away, the family can still grow. And between Nee-chan and Ami both claiming you as their property, I guess that piece is going to be me.
: Yeah, well I’d prefer you don’t go anywhere either since you’re the only one of them I can confidently call my property.
: The feminist part of me hates that, but the brocon part of me has never been happier to hear anything. I’m so conflicted all of a sudden, Nii-chan.
: Noriko. Where are you going and why?
: The beach. Nee-chan has a photo-shoot tomorrow and wants to try and cultivate her new, motherly bond with Ami. The inclusion of me apparently makes that easier.
: What are you going to do then?
: Secretly invite you, of course.
: Oh.
: Well, that was way easier than I thought it’d be.
: You can’t let either of them find out though, okay? It’s apparently harder to connect with Ami while you’re around. So you need to be removed from the picture entirely.
: And if Nee-chan finds out I brought you, she’ll invoke Nakayama Sister Law 19A-B-42L. We do not want that to happen, Onii-chan.
: Why? What does that law do?
: If Nakayama Sister Law 19A-B-42L is invoked, Nee-chan has the right to sacrifice me to a demon of her choice.
: And there’s nothing I can do about it either because that’s the law and laws are meant to be followed.
: Aren’t you an anarchist?
: For actual laws, yeah. Sister Law, though? That’s way bigger and scarier. You think I want to be sacrificed to a demon, Nii-chan? Because I don’t.
: Then why not just invite Kirin instead or something if my inclusion is so dangerous for you?
: Because I like you better than her and want to spend more time with you since I’m pretty sure this is the largest gap in character events any of your love interests have ever had.
: What?
: Just a hunch. Molly’s not the only one who thinks of dating in video game terms.
: ...Is what I would say if I hadn’t already pledged to engage sister-mode.
: Does Nee-chan really give you a blowjob every single morning?
: I don’t even want one sometimes. I think she has a problem.
: So, hypothetically, if someone were to hide a camera in here, where would you least likely check?
: Ami — you almost ready to go? We’re about to- what are you doing?
: Oh. Sorry, Aunt Niki. I just had to do something really quick before we leave.
: Is that “something” increasing the amount of fanservice we have in this game? Because there’s really no other reason for you to be standing like that.
: Fanservice? Whatever do you mean? This is just how I stand when I use my laptop.
: Okay. As long as you’re not only doing it to try and increase the appeal of the game to people who don’t like to read.
: Because, as far as I’m concerned, fanservice is the worst possible way to do that. And I can tell you now that I won’t take any part in it.
: Really? But aren’t we only going to the beach so you can do the photo-shoot for your swimsuit calendar?
: There’s a big difference between gravure photography and overly-gratuitous, weirdly angled upskirt shots. You’ll know what I mean one day, Ami. I’m sure.
: Maybe. And yeah, I’m all packed. Can we really not bring Sensei, though?
: You say that like he’s our dog.
: That’d be nice...
: I can only be disappointed in myself for giving you the opportunity to say that.
: But no — we can not bring your father. If you really want a dog, you have Noriko. That’s close enough.
: But I don’t want to sit on Noriko’s face.
: I’m sure Noriko would be very upset to hear you say that.
: You’ll be fine for two days without Akira, Ami. You’ve done it plenty of times before.
: Plus! This gives you and me more time to do girl stuff! And bond! And this time, we’ll have a third player for Cards Against Humanity! That’s slightly less depressing!
: Yeah...but every time you try to hang out with me, I always make it weird. And I’m tired of disappointing you...
: You don’t disappoint me, Ami! You just gross me out. It’s different.
: That’s even worse! I’d rather you just be disappointed in me. Or, ideally, just generally open to the idea of a father and daughter who sexually experiment together. Every day.
: You’re doing it again.
: But Aunt Niki! What if I never meet or even encounter another boy?!
: Will you really subject me to a life of forced abstinence when there’s a perfectly good dad right across the hall?
: Yes.
: Now, that’s just mean. I bet you’d have sex with your dad if he was the only guy around.
: I am going to pretend you didn’t just say that. Now, go put your shit in the limo.
: Can I maybe just...you know...sample him? With your supervision?
: What is with you creeps and sampling him all of a sudden? This isn’t fucking Costco. And he’s not really desirable in any way whatsoever. I don’t get it.
: Then why do you wake him up with a blowjob every day?
: Because I have a problem, Ami! I love dick, okay?! And if that’s a crime, then lock me up! Because I’m not stopping any time soon!
: I didn’t go over a decade without the touch of a man just for that man’s daughter or my sister to ask me to share! Find your own dick! Akira’s is mine! Got it?!
: Wow.
: That was actually kind of...cool. I really respect you for that outburst, Aunt Niki.
: As a daughter, of course. As a fan, I am heartbroken.
: Grab your shit and get in the car. Now.
: Hah...yes, ma’am. Let me just close my laptop.
: Fine, but if you need to- wait a minute. What- Ami?! What the fuck were you Googling before I walked in?!
: I think trying to Google it would be a more accurate description. There are shockingly few dad and daughter sex tips available on the Internet. I just keep getting called weird.
: You probably just got us put on a list, you fucking idiot! How’s your father going to explain this to the Internet company?!
: He won’t need to! Because thanks to Makoto, we now have NordVPN. And with the following discount code, you too can feel safe and secure online where-
: Don’t hijack my event with ads! We’ve broken the fourth wall enough already and we haven’t even made it to the beach yet!
